command.name: Reset Subsystem(s) to Default
command.description: Resets one or more meter subsystems to factory default configuration.

parameters.name: Command Semaphore
parameters.description: A non-zero value triggers the command execution.

parameters.name: Subsystem Selector
parameters.description: Selects whether to reset a single subsystem or all subsystems.

parameters.name: Subsystem ID
parameters.description: Specifies the subsystem to reset when Subsystem Selector = 1.
